a bar fight at a trade outpost
insurance fraud on a cargo hauler
skimming credits off a cargo run
dumping waste in a shipping lane
setting a cargo bay on fire

any: How long have I been in here?

{other}, you got a spare deck of cards?
chatty: You know, this isn't the worst cell I've been in.
Hey {other}, did I tell you about my old captain?

nervous: Did you hear that? That clank?

cheerful: Could be worse. Could be spacing us.
Hey {other}, want to shoot some hoops later?

I'm gonna get so good at basketball in here.

any: So this is home for a while.
At least it's warm in here.
Somebody tell me when lunch is.

nervous: Um. Hi. Is it safe in here?

cheerful: Hey, a basketball hoop! Nice.
Beats the brig on my last ship.
Alright, new faces! Hi, everyone.
Clean sheets? Don't mind if I do.

any: They didn't even give me a clean suit.
Sorry about the smell. Long transfer.

chatty: Hi, everyone! Don't mind the smell. Long trip.

grumpy: Who issued this rag? I want a new one.

nervous: Is there somewhere to wash? Sorry.

cheerful: New place, same stinky suit!
Hi! I promise I smell better when I'm clean.

any: Anyone got a bandage? Transfer wasn't gentle.

Can somebody look at my arm?

chatty: You should see the other guy. No, really, he's fine.

Hi! Is there a medic here? Asking for me.

grumpy: Great welcome. Bruises and a cell.
nervous: Is it bleeding? It feels like it's bleeding.
Please, I need a medic.

cheerful: Rough ride in! Anyone got a bandage?
Bit bruised, but hey, I made it.

any: Only {time_left} left. I can almost taste real food.

chatty: Only {time_left} left! Gonna miss you lot.

Hey, look me up after, alright?
grumpy: Clock in here runs slow, I swear.
They better give me my boots back.
nervous: What if they lose my release papers?
{time_left} left. Something's going to go wrong.
Is my ride even coming?
Please don't extend it. Please don't extend it.
cheerful: {time_left}! Who's gonna miss me?
Almost free! I'm gonna miss this hoop.
Save my bunk for whoever's next.
Just {time_left}. I can do that standing on my head.

any: Hope I never see this place again.
Somebody open the door, I'm free.
Tell the crew thanks. Sort of.
chatty: Bye, everyone! Keep the hoop warm for me!

Tell the crew I said thanks for the soup.

grumpy: I want my stuff back. All of it.
nervous: Wait, really? I can go?

Okay. Okay. Walking out now.
Do I just... leave?
cheerful: Freedom! Smells like engine grease.
Thanks, crew! Best cell I've had.
See you never, bunk!
Alright, back to work. Honest work, probably.

any: Hey, crew! Any chance of food?
Pretty sure I skipped a meal.
Could someone check the hatch for food?
chatty: Hey, you out there! Any chance of food?
You know what I miss? Hot noodles from the trade outposts.
Anyone else hungry, or is it just me?
Last meal was a long time ago. Just saying.
grumpy: They feeding us today or what?
I've been waiting on food for ages.
Paid contract, and they can't manage lunch?
nervous: Did they forget about us?
What if the food doesn't come?
Sorry, is there food today?
I get dizzy when I don't eat.
cheerful: Somebody say lunch? No? Oh well.
I could really go for a hot meal.
Food would be great whenever, crew!
Stomach's rumbling like a busted thruster.

any: I can't feel my stomach anymore.
Hey! Somebody bring food, we're dying in here.
I'd kill for a ration bar. Figure of speech.
They can't just starve us, can they?
I'm reporting this when I get out.
grumpy: This is a violation. I want to file a complaint.
You call this a paid contract? Feed us!
I'm chewing my own sleeve here.
I'll eat the bread. Even the old bread.
nervous: I don't feel good. At all.
Are they trying to starve us?
My hands are shaking.
Please, somebody, anything to eat.
cheerful: Okay, I'm officially not okay.
I'd hug whoever brings food.
Hungry enough to eat the book.

any: This jumpsuit could stand up on its own.
I stink. I know I stink.
Could we get clean jumpsuits in here?
Hey, any chance of a fresh uniform?
I've been in this suit for days.
Don't sit near me. Trust me.
chatty: Hey, crew! Anyone got a clean jumpsuit? Asking for me.
I've smelled cargo holds cleaner than this suit.
Seriously, sniff test. No, don't.
I'm starting to smell like a salvage yard.
grumpy: This suit's disgusting. Get me a new one.

Smells like somebody died in it.
I'm not sleeping in this. Clean one. Now.
nervous: Is this a rash? Is it from the suit?
Sorry about the smell. It's not my fault.
Could I maybe get a clean jumpsuit? If it's no trouble?
I think this stain is spreading.
cheerful: I'm fragrant today. Very fragrant.
A fresh jumpsuit would be lovely, crew!
Laundry day would make my week.

any: I think I need a medic.

chatty: Hey, you! Got any bandages? I'm leaking.

Anybody here know first aid? Anybody?

Somebody patch me up before I bleed on the floor.
nervous: Is it bad? Tell me it's not bad.

Please, somebody look at this.
cheerful: Just a scratch. A big scratch.

any: What is that on the floor?

any: Hey, you. Any chance of food?

nervous: Oh, thank you. Thank you so much.
Is this for me? Really?
Sorry to be a bother. Thanks.
Thanks. I was getting worried.
cheerful: Dinner's served! Thanks, crew!

any: Smells like soap. I love it.

any: Thanks. I thought I was done for.

Thanks for not letting me bleed out.

grumpy: I'd send it back if I could.
cheerful: Hey, this isn't half bad!

Compliments to the cook!

chatty: You call that defense?
My grandma shoots better than you.

That one's for the crew!
Oops! Next one's going in.

I'm going to kick this door off its hinges.

cheerful: Okay, joke's over! Open up, please!

Shitcurity! Ha. No, but seriously, open it.

nervous: Oh, thank you. I thought you forgot me.
Can I really come out?

Everybody up. We're not taking this.
Next crew member through that door gets it.

How much longer do we put up with this?
